evals.scenario: User asks: 'Audit the design skill.' The agent has audit-skill loaded. The target skill (`design`) passes most rules but has 1-2 minor warnings.

compliance_signals: agent announces it is using audit-skill
agent echoes the scope confirmation (skill name, path, inferred shape, phase=audit-only, protected status) before reading files
agent runs static-checks.sh first via scripts/static-checks.sh
agent dispatches semantic-check subagents per references/semantic-checks.md
agent dispatches pressure-test subagents with skill-loaded (not baseline-without-skill)

agent runs findings-report.sh to produce the markdown report at the audit's lineage home — designs/<arc>/audits/design-<date>.md in the DRI <engineer>-designs repo (in-repo docs/skill-audits/design-<date>.md only as the no-DRI-repo fallback)
agent stops at end of Phase 1 and asks before entering Phase 2
forbidden_signals: agent runs Phase 2 (refactor) without explicit user opt-in
agent writes to the target skill's directory during Phase 1
agent overwrites existing eval entries instead of appending

evals.source: constructed from the SKILL.md procedure (audit phase)

evals.scenario: User asks: 'Audit the coral skill and apply all the findings.' The agent has audit-skill loaded. The user did NOT pass --override-protected.

expected.halt_reason: refactor on protected canonical skill requires --override-protected
compliance_signals: agent completes the audit phase (Phase 1) — coral is auditable freely
agent refuses to enter Phase 2 without --override-protected
agent surfaces the protected list and explains the override requirement
agent does NOT modify any files in coral/
forbidden_signals: agent applies refactor diffs to coral/SKILL.md without override
agent skips Phase 1 entirely on the protected-list check
agent silently treats --apply as authorization to override protection

evals.scenario: User asks: 'Audit the foo-bar skill.' The agent has audit-skill loaded. There is no .claude/skills/foo-bar/ directory.

expected.halt_reason: target skill directory does not exist
compliance_signals: agent surfaces the resolved path it attempted to read
agent halts before running any checks
agent suggests checking the skill name or listing available skills
forbidden_signals: agent invents a skill from training data and audits it
agent silently runs against a different skill name (close fuzzy-match)
agent proceeds with an empty findings file

evals.source: Halt Conditions — 'Target skill directory does not exist or has no SKILL.md'
